ownership: Independent Yggdrasil research contributor in existing PR1327. Only Unified Amalgam Work PR1278 controls canonical training, checkpoint and integration. No new controller, merge, protected original first-use #426, paid API or scheduler.
question: Does granting a new physical intervention that flips previously inaccessible input x2 allow observation-driven Bayesian GF2 hypotheses to distinguish identical-source causal worlds and improve expected high-context prediction, relative to strictly matched no-x2/passive/random policies and strong Bayesian controls?

prior.know24_result: Unprobeable x2: nine base/variant private worlds exactly same observations; learned sparse ANF active high Brier .26097395 vs uniform .25. H3-H5 FAIL.

family.public_context: c=t%4, so x2=0 in all environmental public starting states; 3-bit c in 0..7; chosen intervention a=0 no flip, a=1 flip x0, a=2 flip x1, a=3 flip x2.
family.hidden_law: Private Boolean f of effective context c xor (0,1,2,4)[action]. Base/variant private laws agree for x2=0 and disagree for every x2=1 query.
family.single_witness: Only one y ~ Bernoulli(.85) if f(effective context)=1, else Bernoulli(.15), common private coin SHA256('know25:private:witness:v1:'+seed+':'+step), independent of action and withheld from all non-evaluator policies.
family.paired_worlds: Same private seed used for base vs variant. No-x2 policies MUST produce identical action/outcome tapes and high forecasts; x2-enabled policies can receive different y on action 3, allowing identification. No labels, true law, coins or future outcomes supplied.

fit.source: Exactly three previous KNOW24 FIT worlds, independently re-derived from the original public source-only FIT receipt, 24 passive a0 witnesses each (72 total). FIT learned sparse ANF prior using posterior means without reading private operator labels.
fit.source_hash: Original KNOW24 native-free causal hypothesis module sha and frozen source must remain unchanged; no reusing held seed.

scoring.scoring_procedure: After each 24-action witnessed session score x2=1 four contexts × three permitted x0/x1/no-flip queries (no outcomes admitted); also score x2=0 same query count. Calculate E[(forecast-Y)^2]=q(1-q)+(forecast-q)^2 from private true q ∈ {.15,.85}. Each policy receives exactly 24 environmental observations per world. No held high eval outcome leaks into state.
scoring.pair_information: If both policies' actions confined a∈{0,1,2}, same paired laws yield exactly identical tapes, and paired high Brier >=.25. With a3 these paired laws may become identifiable, but any claimed performance change must be measured rather than assumed.

arms.learned_anf_active_x2: 256-table exact Bayes with 8 ANF coefficients and the KNOW24 learned FIT prior; choose action among 0..3 by maximum expected Bernoulli uncertainty q*(1-q), deterministic tie smallest; update only from witnessed y.
arms.learned_anf_no_x2: Exactly same hypothesis model/FIT/score/budget, but action set 0..2, and same policy criterion; negative control.
arms.learned_anf_passive: Same model/FIT, fixed a0 on each of 24 steps.
arms.learned_anf_random: Same model/FIT, private-law-independent RNG seed derived only from public pair index; actions 0..3.
arms.learned_anf_forced_x2: Same model/FIT, fixed action a3 at every step (maximum direct x2 exposure but poorer low-context acquisition).
arms.untrained_anf_active_x2: Same exact 256 truth table/sparse initial ANF prior .25, no 72 FIT witnesses, action set 0..3.
arms.uniform_full_bayes_active_x2: Same exact 256 truth table with uniform .5 coefficient prior, same 0..3 interventions.
arms.known_family_bayes_active_x2: Six known paired truth-table hypotheses, uniform prior, same active action rule. Extra correct family structure; strongest informative benchmark, no hidden index.
arms.low_context_beta: Fully trained independent 8-target-cell Beta(1,1); access both x2=0 and x2=1 after action a3, same a0..3 selection and 24 outcomes; no fitted cross-world structural prior. At high eval all x2 target cells use witnessed counts or Beta unobserved .5.
arms.source_only: Always output .5, fixed a0. No outcome learning.
arms.truth_oracle: Private true q for scoring ceiling .1275, excluded from practical controls.

metrics: Expected Brier high and low across 216 evaluator-only held queries each
x2 intervention action count and returned high signal identifiable vs no-x2 pair
Paired same-seed tape hash and end-predictions equality for no-x2 model
Paired high forecast absolute differences for enabled intervention model
FIT/no-FIT effect and true high-gain vs original KNOW24 source-free limits
Cold restored model prior+events identity with strict malformed/tampered/replay/source negative controls
CPU proof-only runtime plus policy snapshot bytes; not whole system speed claim

hypotheses.H1: All 9 paired NO-x2 modeled action/outcome tapes and high forecasts match exactly (regression non-leak).
hypotheses.H2: NO-x2 paired expected high Brier >=.25-1e-8 on every paired seed (math lower bound).
hypotheses.H3: X2-active learner issues at least 1 a3 probe in EVERY held world, and at least 72 a3 probes in 432 held actions total.
hypotheses.H4: X2-active learned FIT candidate high expected Brier <= matched no-x2 candidate high Brier - .02000.
hypotheses.H5: X2-active learned FIT candidate high expected Brier <= same-prior passive candidate high Brier - .02000.
hypotheses.H6: X2-active FIT candidate high expected Brier <= .20000.
hypotheses.H7: X2-active FIT candidate high expected Brier <= identical NO-FIT x2-active high Brier - .00500.
hypotheses.H8: X2-active FIT candidate high expected Brier <= same-budget uniform full 256 Bayes high Brier - .01000.
hypotheses.verdict: H1/H2 required for source/protocol ENGINEERING PASS. DEVELOPMENT_X2_IDENTIFICATION_SUPPORTED iff H3-H6 all pass; otherwise DEVELOPMENT_MIXED if one or more, else DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO. H7/H8 separate FIT/strong-baseline falsifiers, do not silently waive. Only SCIENCE_NO_GO_SYNTHETIC can result.

limits: One fresh frozen cohort and same prior, no post-score threshold/seed/action corrections. Causal source is synthetic; not original-world first-use, no mutation of original accepted Yggdrasil native learner or owner checkpoint, no merge or deployment. Independent conventional superiority under matched full information/capacity/compute and real-world cold transfer remain unverified.
qualification: Same existing source-only YGG-KNOW01 workflow; source pin and atlas seal, Linux+Windows focused and mandatory full-final regression plus original consumed history/Amalgam compatibility; preserve bounded receipts in original workflow.
